mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 7.5% signals labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 7.5%, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates housing market strength, accelerating consumer spending and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint RSAFS/HOUST growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or interaction term coefficient negative in regression.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signals manufacturing weakness, triggering economic slowdown expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >50% of INDPRO < 95 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >50% of GDPC1 growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals rising price pressures, prompting Fed tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >50% of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) signal labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits for positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS growth/UNRATE decline fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >50% of cases, or interaction term coefficient negative.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals manufacturing strength, driving economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >50% of INDPRO > 100 periods, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 5-year windows.
